title: MCP contract shared types
description: Shared types for the MCP tool contracts: IDs, keys, dates, paging, labels, principals and the engine meaning lists. Field names follow document 20, section 3.3. Configuration references travel as keys. Operational references travel as IDs.
$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 1). The engine meaning lists below are fixed values the engine reads. Every label stays configurable and maps to one meaning. Document 20, section 2.4.

guid.description: An Entra object ID or application ID, written as a GUID.

id.description: The ID of an operational row. Configuration rows never travel as IDs, only as keys.

key.description: A configuration key. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1 to 64 characters, starting with a letter. Document 20, section 3.2.

toolName.description: A tool name: lowercase snake_case, verb first.

recordUrl.description: A link to a record on the product's page: an HTTPS URL, or on a local run with no public base URL the loopback address the request came to, such as http://127.0.0.1:5081/app/records/review/<id> (document 24, B24-17).

dateTime.description: An ISO date and time in UTC, ending in Z.

reasonCode.description: An engine reason code: lowercase, dot-separated, never reused. Document 25, section 7.

guidelineNumber.description: A guideline number, such as G17 (C39 Guideline).

clientRequestId.description: The caller's own ID for this request. A retry with the same value returns the first result and writes nothing new. A reused value with a different payload returns conflict.

validateOnly.description: True runs every rule and returns what would be written, without writing. Lets an AI client show the person the result first.

top.description: Page size. The server caps it at the mcp-page-size-max setting (100 by default).

skipToken.description: The token from the previous page. It encodes the query, not server state.

nextSkipToken.description: Pass this value as skipToken to get the next page. Absent on the last page.

labelledKey.description: A configuration row by key, with its label.

displayLabel.description: A name to show people. Refreshed when seen.

directoryObject.description: An Entra object by ID, with a label. Read live, never a copy of the directory.

displayLabel.description: A name to show people. An erased person shows as former user.

principalRef.description: A Principal Reference (O05): an Entra object ID with a label.

label.description: The label from the client-app value list, such as Claude Code.

clientApp.description: The MCP client or application that made the call.

statusValue.description: A status label and its engine meaning, such as { label: "Draft", meaning: "draft" }. Logic reads the meaning, never the label.

statusMeaning.description: Any status engine meaning. Each entity uses its own list.

recordStatusMeaning.description: Record status meaning, for an Intake Request (O07) or a Change Request (O11).

decisionStatusMeaning.description: Decision status meaning, for a Decision (O09).

registrationStatusMeaning.description: Registration status meaning, for a Business Application (O02).

approvalOutcomeMeaning.description: Approval outcome meaning, for an Approval Record (O10).

documentStatusMeaning.description: Document status meaning, for a Document Link (O19). Missing is computed and never stored.

claimStatusMeaning.description: Claim status meaning, for a Claim (O23).

deploymentResultMeaning.description: Deployment result meaning, for a Deployment Record (O14).

reviewStatusMeaning.description: Review status meaning, for a Review (O21).

draftStatusMeaning.description: Draft status meaning, for a Configuration Draft (C46).

lifecycleMeaning.description: Lifecycle meaning of a Lifecycle Stage (C12).

actorKindMeaning.description: Actor kind meaning (C38). It comes from the entry point and the token, never from a caller field.

principalKind.description: Principal kind (O05). Only a user can approve. Roles bind only to groups.

requirementKind.description: Requirement kind (C14): how the engine tests a gate requirement. data-uses-declared and data-uses-decided come with the data taxonomy (OP-07).

directoryState.description: Directory State (O05), as last read from Entra by the owner check.

key.description: The key of the group: a configuration key, or the Portfolio ID when grouped by portfolio. Null for rows with no value, such as an application with no tier yet.

approvalNeeded.description: One approval a decision needs, resolved from the single most specific Approval Rule group (C32). Exactly one of approverRoleKey, approverOwnerRoleKey and approverProposedOwners.

approverProposedOwners.description: Set when each person the decision proposes to make an owner must approve, by name: the successor and any new deputy (C32 Approver Proposed Owners).

minimumCount.description: How many counted approvals the rule needs. Zero only for the locked list the engine may accept without an approval request.

ownerSubject.description: Where the owner role is held when it is not the application's: the data domain a use touches, its parent, the data location, or each domain a configuration change touches (C32 Owner Subject). Absent for an owner role on the application.

isConsultation.description: Set for a consulted role (C32 Is Consultation): it is asked once the decision is submitted, and its answer is advice that never counts. Absent for an approval.

ownerAssignmentId.description: Pass it as endAssignmentId to propose_owner_change.

deputyFor.description: The main assignment this deputy covers.

startOn.description: When the assignment starts. Null while it waits for its ownership decision.

endOn.description: When it ends. Null while current.

ownershipDecisionId.description: The decision that made the assignment.

ownerAssignment.description: One principal holding one owner role for one application (O06).

ownerGap.description: An owner role with no holder or no deputy.

idempotencyKey.description: The sender's retry key, such as run ID plus stage plus attempt. A retry with the same key returns the existing record and writes nothing new (I-189).

linkKindKey.description: A link kind of the evidence category.

url.description: Opens the proof. Checked against the link kind's Url Pattern and the forbidden URL patterns.

evidenceInput.description: One link to proof held elsewhere. It becomes an Evidence Link (O20).

outsideWindow.description: Finished outside the linked change's window.

otherPath.description: The route is not an allowed route of the target's change path.

missingApproval.description: No authorization where the policy expects one.

aiOnlyCodeApproval.description: The only reported code approval came from an AI. It never counts as authorization.

deploymentFlags.description: The flags the engine computes on a Deployment Record (O14). Callers never set them.

approvalsSummary.description: Counts of the approval records of one decision.

decisionSubjectKind.description: The kind of record a Decision (O09) is about. The data taxonomy adds a data use (O27), a data mapping (O26), a data domain (C49, for its ownership) and a data location (O25, for its ownership).

changeManagementMode.description: Change management mode (D-08): built in, or linked to the client's ITSM tool.

deploymentRouteMeaning.description: Deployment route meaning (C36). Set by the engine from the entry point.

codeApprovalKind.description: Who approved the code merge, as reported. Evidence only, never authorization.

standardChangeConditionKind.description: A condition kind of a Standard Change Model (C21), document 25, OP-12.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of a snapshot, as lowercase hex.

entityKey.description: An entity key: the kebab-case form of a logical entity name, such as gate-policy.

keyPath.description: A configuration key, or for a child row the parent key, a slash, then the child key.

principal.description: The principal behind the write (Performed By Principal).

onBehalfOf.description: The person an AI client or pipeline acted for. Null when a person acted directly.

clientAppLabel.description: The client app label the engine stamped, such as Claude Code or the web app. Null when the call carried none.

stampedOn.description: When the engine checked the write (Engine Checked On).

draftedBy.description: The AI client that created the row and the person it acted for (document 22, B22-15: Drafted By Client App and Drafted For Principal), kept when a person edits the row later. Null for a row no AI client created.

clientAppLabel.description: The AI client, such as Claude Code. Null when the call carried none.

forPrincipal.description: The person the AI client acted for.

stampedBy.description: Who made a row's last engine-checked write, exactly as the engine stamped it (document 24, section 4.5), as a read returns it. Unlike a write's performedBy it carries the client app label only: the app ID is not stored on the row.

dataHandlingRule.description: A data handling rule (docs/architecture/data-taxonomy.md, The main fields). Strictness rises in this order. never: nobody may save a use or a copy it governs (G-25).

dataUseState.description: The decision state of a data use or a copy, computed when read (OP-16; docs/architecture/data-taxonomy.md, The decision state). Never stored.

dataOrigin.description: Where a data mapping's data comes from (O26 Data Origin).

dataAccess.description: How a data use reaches the data (O27 Access).

dataDomainRef.description: A data domain (C49) by key, with its label and its path in the tree.

path.description: The labels from the top of the tree down to this domain, joined by " / ", such as "People / Payroll".

dataClassificationValue.description: The effective classification of a data domain (OP-15).

label.description: The classification's label: the tenant's sensitivity label name.

setOn.description: The domain that sets it: the domain itself, or the nearest one above it.

dataRuleValue.description: One effective handling rule and where it comes from (OP-15).

setOn.description: The domain whose explicit value is the strictest. Null when the classification's default governs.

fromClassification.description: The classification whose default governs. Null when a domain sets the rule.

dataRules.description: The three effective handling rules of a data domain.

use.description: Reads and writes that do not reach AI.

ai.description: Uses that reach an AI model.

dataPersonValue.description: Who holds an owner role on a data domain, own or inherited (OP-15).

inheritedFrom.description: The domain above whose owner answers. Null when the domain names its own.

dataApprover.description: One approver a data decision asks (OP-16 through OP-02 and OP-15).

kind.description: role: the members of a product role's group answer. owner-role: the person who holds the owner role is asked by name.

role.description: The product role (C29), for kind role.

ownerRole.description: The owner role (C28), for kind owner-role.

ownerSubject.description: Where the owner role is resolved, such as data-domain or business-application.

principal.description: The person asked by name. Null for a product role, or when nobody holds the owner role.

inheritedFrom.description: The domain above whose owner answers.

isConsultation.description: True for a consultation: the person is asked, and the answer does not count.

noOneToAsk.description: True when the owner role resolves to nobody who can act now.

label.description: The location's name when last seen.

stage.description: The effective target stage: its own, or its parent's.

stampedOrNull.description: Who last wrote the row, as the engine stamped it. Null for a seeded row.

dataUseItem.description: One data use (O27) with its computed decision state.

location.description: Where the application reaches the data, when known.

purpose.description: Why the application needs the data.

reachesAi.description: True when the data is sent to an AI model or agent.

aiServiceAsSeen.description: The model or service as named.

isDeidentified.description: True when only masked or de-identified data is used.

accessApproach.description: How the application signs in to the data (access-approach list).

approvalsNeeded.description: The counted approvals a decision needs.

approvalsGiven.description: For a proposed decision, the counted approvals so far: "1 of 2 approvals".

decisionId.description: The decision the state comes from: the accepted one, else the proposed one.

isAiCreated.description: True when an AI client created the row.

dataMappingItem.description: One data mapping (O26): this domain's data sits at this location.

containers.description: Container names as seen, such as tables. Empty means the whole location.

copyState.description: For a copy outside production: its decision state under the copy rule. Null for any other mapping.

approvalsNeeded.description: The counted approvals a copy decision needs.

isAiCreated.description: True when an AI client created the row.

dataLocationItem.description: One data location (O25): a store from any vendor, held as a link.

parent.description: The instance this store sits in.

stage.description: The effective target stage: its own, or its parent's.

isProduction.description: True when the effective stage is a production stage (C34 Is Production).

hostedByApplication.description: The business application this system is.

externalId.description: The tool's own ID. Restricted read: null for a caller who holds only the reader role.

url.description: Opens the location in its own tool. Restricted read like externalId.

fromParent.description: True when the holder is the parent location's technical owner.

domains.description: The domains mapped here, open mappings only.

childCount.description: Open locations whose parent is this one.

draft.description: Not confirmed by a person yet.

stale.description: Not seen for data-location-stale-days, or never seen.

noTechnicalOwner.description: Nobody holds the technical owner role on it or on its parent.

copyOutsideProduction.description: It holds a production copy or a masked copy, and its stage is not production.

isAiCreated.description: True when an AI client created the row.

dataFinding.description: One data check finding (OP-17; docs/architecture/data-taxonomy.md, Data checks).

check.description: The data check, DC-01 to DC-14.

subjectKind.description: What the finding is about, such as data-domain or data-use.

subjectId.description: The subject: a domain key, or a row ID.

message.description: One sentence that names the rule, the domain and the fix.

principal.description: The person the finding names, such as the domain's acting data owner.

ownerRoleKey.description: For DC-03 and DC-04: the owner role the finding is about, such as data-owner. Null for other checks.

isDeputy.description: For DC-03 and DC-04: true when the person the finding names is the role's deputy. Null for other checks.

suggestion.description: For DC-10: the offer "declare?", with each other application this one reads data from or writes data to and the domains that application holds (document 24, B24-22). Null for other checks, and for an application that only uses AI.

dataCounts.description: How much points at a data domain.

openDecisions.description: Proposed decisions about the domain, its uses or its mappings.

dataDomainItem.description: One data domain (C49) as the tree shows it.

path.description: The labels from the top, joined by " / ".

declarable.description: True when uses and mappings may point at this domain's level.

gaps.description: The owner gaps of this domain (DC-01 to DC-04).

approvalAsked.description: One approval request a submission started.

askedPrincipal.description: The person asked by name, when the request names one.

impliedAnswer.description: The tier answer a data domain's classification implies (C47 Implied Answer).

domain.description: The domain whose classification implies it.

dataGoverningRule.description: The rule that governs a data use or a copy, and where it is set.

name.description: Which rule governs: the use rule, the AI use rule, or the copy rule.

setOn.description: The domain that sets it. Null when the classification's default governs.

title.description: The guideline title, without its number.

url.description: The adopter's own copy, else the hub link. Null when neither is set.

guidelineRef.description: The guideline a requirement, a gate, an approval rule or a refusal applies, as a chip the pages show (document 24, B24-18).
